hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (held near 250 MHz by power and thermal limits)

proposals.statement: The client has a problem with double bookings because someone rubs out a booking and someone else writes over it

evidence.quote: someone rubbed out a booking and someone else wrote over it

proposals.statement: The client has a problem with no-shows, with about twenty per week across three clinics

evidence.quote: we have maybe twenty no-shows a week across the three clinics

proposals.statement: The client has a problem with phone calls not being handled properly, with mornings being the worst time between eight and ten

evidence.quote: Mornings are the worst. Between eight and ten the phones just don't stop

proposals.statement: The client wants fewer missed calls, no double bookings, and fewer no-shows

evidence.quote: the goals are fewer missed calls, no double bookings, and fewer no-shows

proposals.statement: The client uses VetDesk Pro for clinical records, owners' details, vaccination history, and billing

evidence.quote: VetDesk Pro, yes. That's where all the clinical records live, the owners' details, vaccination history, billing

proposals.statement: The client uses paper diaries at reception for each clinic

evidence.quote: All three clinics, Centurion, Irene and Olievenhoutbosch, have their own landline and their own paper diary at reception

proposals.statement: The client has a problem with receptionists burning out due to phone calls and checking people in and taking payments
The client wants to have the system live by the first of February at the latest

evidence.quote: Before vaccination season. So live by the first of February at the latest

proposals.statement: The client wants the system to be live by mid-January ideally

evidence.quote: Ideally mid-January, so the girls have two weeks to get used to it before the rush

proposals.statement: The client has put aside 180,000 rand to build the system and wants running costs for messages and hosting to stay under 2,500 rand a month for all three clinics

evidence.quote: We've put aside a hundred and eighty thousand rand to build it. And the running costs, the messages and the hosting, must stay under two and a half thousand a month for all three clinics

proposals.statement: The client wants the system to use their green color, have big buttons, and no app download, just a web page

evidence.quote: Our green, the logo green. Big buttons, because half the people booking are holding a puppy in the other hand. And no app to download, just a web page

proposals.statement: The client wants the system to be simple with one screen if possible

evidence.quote: And simple. One screen if possible. The VetDesk screens have about forty fields on them, I don't want that

proposals.statement: The client wants to know where they draw the line for emergencies that can be booked online

evidence.quote: I need to talk to the other vets about where we draw that line

proposals.statement: The client wants to know if they should use SMS or WhatsApp for reminders

evidence.quote: What about the reminders, SMS or WhatsApp?

proposals.statement: The client must not share owners' phone numbers with another company for its own purposes

evidence.quote: Owners' phone numbers are personal information. We may use them for their pet's appointments and reminders, but nothing else, no marketing, and we may not hand them to another company to use for its own purposes

proposals.statement: The client must record consent for owners who book online

evidence.quote: Then whatever we build has to record that consent itself, and anyone who books online has to agree before we send them anything

proposals.statement: The client must have a written agreement with the company that sends messages under POPIA

evidence.quote: the company that sends the messages would be an operator under POPIA, so you'd need a written agreement with them

proposals.statement: The client expects the system to handle about 160 appointments per day on a normal day, doubling during vaccination season

evidence.quote: a hundred and sixty on a normal day, doubling in vaccination season

proposals.statement: The client has a problem with the paper diary being used because receptionists hate VetDesk's calendar

evidence.quote: We tried its calendar years ago and the receptionists hated it, so the paper diary came back
